records.source: T1 time revision (1 game day = 15 real min); provisional until its owner module
records.note: DECISION T1: one game day = 15 real minutes, identical at sea and ashore, fixed rate, no acceleration. 1 game hour = 37.5 s, a 4 h watch = 150 s. Time stops only for planning screens and the Morning Report.
